messages:
Priya: Quick sync  Orion pre-renewal QBR. Need a compact cost packet: 60/90d token trend, top token drivers, and a 1-page ops ask with exact support requests. Who owns?
Dan: Ill take 60/90d trend + scenario table (base / +25% activation / -15% after optim). Will flag any single-day >30% monthly share. ETA: EOD.
Marta: Ill sample top templates and tag heavy families (embeds, long-transcript summarization, multi-shot email gen). Will add avg tokens/call and 1-line mitigation each.
Jules: Ill draft the one-pager (3 asks) and customer-friendly wording: quota bump, 1 sprint dev for prompt refactor, and an enablement session. Will post WIP to #customer-docs.
Dan: Quick headline numbers from billing view: MRR $12.1k, avg tokens/day 1.15M, est monthly infer cost ~$3.45k. CSV will include scenarios.
billing-bot: Forecast uploaded: /team-shared/orion/forecasts/2890012345.csv
Priya: Thresholds to call out in deck: MTD +15% and +30% absolute. Also highlight any day >35% of monthly tokens.
Marta: Mitigations short list for the deck:
- short-term: set +15% MTD alert, temporary throttle windows, set owner tags
- mid-term: enable prefix caching, trim few-shot examples, schedule embedding batches overnight
- long-term: pipeline rewrite for heavy summarization jobs
Dan: Scenario snippet for the one-pager:
```
Scenario,EstMonthlyCost
Base,$3,450
Activation+25%,$4,312
Optimized-15%,$2,933
```
Jules: One-pager will also include 2 example prompts we ask the customer to consider lowering fidelity on (long transcript TL;DR and bulk-embed high-recall).
ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Orion QBR prep Wed 10:30am PT. Invite shared with participants.
Priya: Add a 2-question poll to the enablement: 1) Which jobs can be moved to nightly windows? 2) Which outputs can accept lower fidelity to save tokens? Capture answers live.
Dan: Ill add a peak-day monitor for 48h and post here if we see >20% day-over-day spike.
Marta: Ill link a short playbook with concrete configs at /team-playbooks/orion-costs.md and attach to the one-pager.
Jules: WIP one-pager posted to #customer-docs. Feedback welcome; will finalize by tomorrow morning.
Priya: Thanks team. If any surprises in the forecast or spikes, call it out here and well escalate quota or mitigation plan. :thumbsup:
